methods.prompt: Try a small specific mechanical or software invention that solves one concrete part of the problem. Name an observable output and a needed input.
Mutate exactly one interface or step of the existing process. State the changed part and what unchanged ancestry must be preserved.
Reorder or vary a repeating pattern in the process. Describe a change in sequence that has an observable benefit.
Reverse a dependency or swap producer and consumer perspectives. Expose a potential cycle or incompatible assumption.
Find a second substantially different pathway to a similar result, preferably through a different available capability.
Name two available capabilities and propose a typed adapter that might connect their actual output and input contracts.
Retain two unresolved interpretations of a gap. Explain what source evidence or independent witness would distinguish them.
